Live recorder coverage for the authored shotlist path (shotlist arc item b, the url-shot complement to promo_shotlist_happy_path's slide-only item c). A promo run whose brief.shotlist carries two `url` shots makes the `site_capture` stage actually drive the video_production_service recorder against a live URL — the one path the slide-only scenario deliberately skips. site_capture is a no-dep opt-in leaf, so pause_after_stages:[site_capture] lets ONLY the recorder fire (plus the concurrent no-dep promo_analyze hop) and pauses before promo_script/promo_narrate/promo_render — no TTS, no slide render, no compile. Uses https://example.com (IANA-reserved demo domain, stable fast TLS, same as website_review/app_review) so the capture doesn't depend on a brittle resolver. Stage assertions prove the recorder produced one screen per authored url shot (>=2 distinct screens[].id, deterministically shot-000..shot-001 == each shot's line_id), each with a real image_url, and that page text was extracted — a green `paused` alone would not catch a regression where authored url shots silently failed to capture. NOTE: this drives the live recorder + a headless browser, so it is heavier and flakier than the slide-only guard — kept as a separate matrix entry with a generous deadline.

FLOOR PINNED, NOT RE-SIZED (recorded 2026-09-03). `site_capture screens[].id >= 2` looks fragile blueprint-wide -- MEASURED over a 90-day window of completed `stage_outputs` on promo_v1 the distinct screen count is min 0 (n=58) -- but that minimum comes from promo runs that author NO url shots at all and therefore capture nothing, not from this scenario under-delivering. Here the count is a CONTRACT: the brief authors exactly 2 `kind: url` shots and site_capture captures one screen per authored url shot, so 2 is pinned by the input. Lowering it would stop the assertion proving the second (scrolled) capture happened at all, which is the url-shot coverage this scenario exists for. tests/test_e2e_scenario_contracts.py now derives the pin from the count of `kind: url` entries in `project.brief.shotlist` and requires this floor to EQUAL it.
